exercises.why: **приказали** — приказа́ть (perfective): to order, to command, to give orders, to direct. Wiktionary: при- + каза́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to add (to perform the arithmetical operation of addition)
to get used (to), to get accustomed
presence, attendance (the fact or condition of being present)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: привести́ — to bring (someone with); приба́вить — to add (to perform the arithmetical operation of addition); привы́кнуть — to get used (to), to get accustomed; прису́тствие — presence, attendance (the fact or condition of being present).
**принимаю** — принима́ть (imperfective): to take; to admit, to accept; to receive; to assume. Wiktionary: при- + -нима́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

pairs: to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something)
to see, to catch sight of, to notice
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: призна́ть — to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something); приноси́ть — to bring (by foot), to fetch; уви́деть — to see, to catch sight of, to notice; узна́ть — to recognize.
**приносил** — приноси́ть (imperfective): to bring (by foot), to fetch; to yield, to bear; to offer (apologies, thanks, etc.). Wiktionary: при- + носи́ть.
